{{pov|[[Gareth Bryne]]}}

[[Gareth Bryne]] and his ex-soldiers are still following [[Siuan Sanche]], [[Leane Sharif]], and [[Min Farshaw]] (though he still doesn't know their true identities). He has reached [[Lugard]], where they pick up the trail again. Even though it doesn't seem to be worth traveling so far to catch them, Gareth will not stop. Gareth tells his men a story of how Siuan and [[Elaida]] had [[Morgase]] order him to move guards back from the [[Murandy|Murandian]] border some years ago but he never found out why.
